description: Header file defining a multi-dimensional tensor interface with static and dynamic implementations, including methods for views, resizing, and data access.

classes.name: tensor
classes.description: Base interface for multi-dimensional tensors supporting views, element access, and resizing.

classes.name: static_tensor
classes.description: Resizable tensor with static memory up to a maximum number of elements.

classes.name: dynamic_tensor
classes.description: Dynamically resizable tensor with heap allocation.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Returns a view of the lowest N dimensions, either mutable or const.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses an element by multi-dimensional indices.

methods.name: get_dimensions_size
methods.description: Returns the size of each dimension.

methods.name: get_dimension_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific dimension.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the tensor to specified dimensions.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves memory for the tensor (dynamic tensor only).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns total number of elements in the tensor (dynamic tensor only).

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is empty (dynamic tensor only).
